desc:
SOFT BAKED GOODNESS: Nature Valley Blueberry Oat Soft Baked Bars are a quick and easy breakfast snack, lunch box treat, or for any time you are looking to fuel your family

BREAKFAST BARS: Made with whole grains, real fruit, flaxseeds, and chia seeds for a wholesome start to your day; 20g of whole grain per serving (at least 48g recommended daily)

QUALITY INGREDIENTS: No artificial flavors, no artificial colors, and no high fructose corn syrup

GREAT ON THE GO: Hearty-size breakfast bars provide great taste on the go; Toss an individually wrapped bar in a backpack, tote, or school snack bag

CONTAINS: One 8.85 oz box of Nature Valley Blueberry Oat Soft Baked Breakfast Bars
features:
Key Features:

Soft-Baked Texture

Feels like eating a muffin—moist, chewy, and flavorful.

Made with Whole Grains

Delivers 20g of whole grains per bar to support healthy digestion and sustained energy.

Includes Real Blueberry Pieces

Gives a naturally sweet and fruity taste.

No Artificial Additives

Contains no artificial flavors, colors, or high-fructose corn syrup.

On-the-Go Friendly

Each bar is individually wrapped—perfect for busy mornings, travel, school, or office snacks.

Nutrient-Rich Ingredients

Contains wholesome elements like flax and chia seeds.

Benefits:

Quick & Healthy Breakfast Option

Saves time while still offering a nutritious morning bite.

Keeps You Full Longer

Thanks to fiber-rich whole grains and complex carbs.

Tasty Yet Wholesome

Sweet blueberry flavor satisfies cravings without excessive sugar or additives.

Great for All Ages

Ideal for kids, teens, and adults as a snack or part of a light breakfast.

Easy to Pack and Store

Fits easily into backpacks, lunchboxes, or handbags for a grab-and-go solution.
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Whole Grain Wheat Flour, Sugar, Canola and Palm Oil, Dried Blueberries, Vegetable Glycerin, Corn Syrup, Chia Seeds, Flaxseeds, Chicory Root Extract, Sugarcane Fiber, Honey, Raisin Juice Concentrate, Baking Soda, Molasses, Salt, Egg Whites, Sunflower Oil, Soy Lecithin, Natural Flavor, Fructose, Nonfat Milk.
